passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage decides which version of the VertBek applies by analogy to lex mitior. That concerns applying the notice over time, not the Erläuterungen's status as an interpretive aid.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage uses the VertBek as an Orientierungshilfe for horizontal agreements. That is a different question from the Erläuterungen's role as an interpretive aid to the VertBek.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The court states that the notices are not legally binding and contain only general qualifications, but nothing is decided with this in the window. Borderline: it is the nearest neighbouring rule, but it is only restated.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: Like passage 2, this treats the VertBek as an Orientierungshilfe for horizontal agreements, which is another legal question.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage deals with business secrets and the publication of WEKO decisions, which is procedure.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage deals with scope, jurisdiction and reserved provisions under Art. 3 KG.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage concerns the change in the significance test under Ziffer 11 and 12 VertBek 2010, which is another rule of the notice.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The passage concerns the authorities' duty to inform the public under Art. 49 KG and the presumption of innocence.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: WEKO lists the EU guidelines among the texts it took into account and justifies this by the legislator's will to align with EU law, but no step of the case is decided with them in the passage.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: This concerns the interpretation of the air transport agreement (LVA) and which law applies to routes, not the analogous application of the EU vertical guidelines.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: This is a euro-compatible interpretation of the telecommunications act (FMG) by ComCom, a different legal question from the vertical notice.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The court restates from the legislative history that Swiss law parallels EU law for legal certainty, and limits it, without using the guidelines to decide anything in the window; borderline with partial, so the weaker label.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: Footnotes cite the EU guidelines on agency contracts as a comparison, without anything being decided in the passage.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: This is a statement of analogous policy with the EU and footnote citations of the VertBek and the EU guidelines; nothing is done with it.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: The EU parallelism is discussed for Art. 7 KG (dominance), another legal question.

passages.label: partial
passages.quote:
In Bezug auf vertikale Abreden verkennt die Beschwerdeführerin sodann, dass der
Wertungsgehalt der Vertikalabreden im KG mit demjenigem im europäischen Recht praktisch deckungsgleich ist
passages.why: The court rejects the appellant's argument using the neighbouring principle that Swiss and EU vertical law share the same values, not the notice's analogous application of the guidelines itself.

passages.label: applies
passages.quote: Vorliegend sind keine Elemente ersichtlich, welche auf eine Ausnahme von der grundsätzlichen Erheblichkeit der vertikalen Preisabreden hinweisen würden. Somit stellen die vertikalen Preisabreden zwischen Husqvarna CH und ihren Händlern erhebliche Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen im Sinne von Art. 5 Abs. 4 i.V.m. Abs. 1 KG dar.
passages.why: WEKO states the rule that Art. 5(4) agreements are as a rule significant, applies it to Husqvarna's price agreements and finds them significant restraints.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: WEKO only quotes the BVGer's Gaba/Gebro reasoning on significance; the window cuts off before it applies that reasoning to its own case.

passages.label: partial
passages.quote: Wenn nämlich das Kartellgesetz selbst in Art. 5 Abs. 4 KG statuiert, dass solche Verbote vermutungsweise den Wettbewerb beseitigen, so ist a maiore ad minus
passages.why: The court derives the rule (a maiore ad minus) and points to the clause in Ziff. 3 of the licence agreement, but the conclusion is fragmentary; borderline, so the weaker label.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: No Art. 5(4) agreements are found, so the general weighing of qualitative and quantitative criteria under Ziff. 12 VertBek applies, which is another rule.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: Concerns the significance of horizontal hardcore cartels (buyer cartels), a different legal question.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: General significance test with market definition for an agreement found not to be a price agreement; not the rule for Art. 5(4) agreements.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: Only restates Art. 5(1) KG under a heading on territorial protection; the window ends before any significance assessment; borderline with unrelated.

passages.label: applies
passages.quote: Es genügt somit, dass Abreden den Wettbewerb potentiell beeinträchtigen können. Insofern zielen die Ausführungen der Beschwerdeführerin, die zum einen auf fehlende tatsächliche Auswirkungen und zum anderen auf eine angeblich nicht erfolgte Umsetzung der Abrede rekurriert, an der Sache vorbei.
passages.why: The Federal Supreme Court applies the rules on potential effect and on no market reference, rejecting the appellant's arguments as beside the point and as unnecessary.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: It restates in general terms when an online-sales ban can fall under Art. 5(4) KG, with no case decided in the window.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: It restates the Art. 5(4) presumption and discusses why parallel imports are lacking; none of the proposition's exclusions is invoked.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: It lists, as general guidance, the qualifying circumstances under which online-sales restrictions suggest Art. 5(4) KG, and applies none of them.

passages.label: partial
passages.quote: ergab die Vorabklärung keine genügenden Anhaltspunkte für eine Behinderung von Parallelimporten bzw. unzulässige Gebietsabsprachen gemäss Art. 5 Abs. 4 i.V.m. Abs. 1 KG
passages.why: In an inquiry into currency advantages not being passed on, it finds no Art. 5(4) agreement without evidence, but the price-difference rule itself is only implicit (borderline, weaker label).

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: It is about indirect territorial allocation falling under Art. 5(4) KG, which is not one of the proposition's exclusions.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: The point that protection is not absolute while passive sales remain possible is only quoted; what the passage actually does is apply the positive presumption to export bans.

passages.label: unrelated
passages.why: It applies the Art. 5(4) presumption to a non-supply agreement, the positive rule rather than any of the exclusions.

passages.label: recites
passages.why: It states that an active-sales ban does not fall under the presumption, but does nothing with that point in the window.
